detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Copyparty is a file server in one Python file. It has resumable multithreaded uploads with deduplication, and it speaks WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, and SMB too. I set it up as a user-level systemd service so permissions match my files with no PUID/PGID juggling. The reboot gotcha is linger, so turn that on.

https://techhut.tv/copyparty-file-server-linux

#SelfHosted #Homelab #Linux
